scope.summary: Tool metric label cardinality is bounded order-independently: an injectable advertised-tool allowlist (OnceLock, set once at startup) collapses every unadvertised tools/call name to a single <other> sentinel, replacing the order-sensitive numeric cap an attacker could pre-fill to displace legitimate series. The allowlist is seeded at the one production Metrics::new() site with the built-in registry tool names chained with the loaded custom tools.
out_of_scope: the prior numeric 512-series overflow cap (retained as a secondary bound, not the primary defense)

entry_points.name: tools/call metric label canonicalization
entry_points.trace: crates/oraclemcp-telemetry/src/metrics.rs defines UNADVERTISED_TOOL_LABEL "<other>" and set_advertised_tools (OnceLock allowlist); the label mechanism landed in c436e5cc. main.rs seeds it at the production Arc::new(Metrics::new()) site from registry::tool_names chained with CustomToolCatalog::names (new, custom_tools.rs:770), landed in 8234ce5e and left in delivered state at source bc0f97c5. Advertised built-in and custom tools keep their own series; arbitrary client names collapse to one sentinel. cargo test -p oraclemcp-telemetry / -p oraclemcp.

limitations: Scoped regression proof only; full-workspace gate green in CI at HEAD 5031d67e. source.sha bc0f97c5 is the commit that leaves all three scope files in their delivered state (metrics.rs last touched 09447852, main.rs 8234ce5e, custom_tools.rs bc0f97c5); the mechanism/wiring landed in c436e5cc + 8234ce5e.
